_meta.title: Always spawn agents for fix/diagnose/saa
_meta.description: When a message starts with saa, diagnose, or fix, block inline edits and require an Agent spawn instead. No inline work, even for small items.

trigger_words.label: Trigger words
trigger_words.help: Message prefixes that must be followed by an Agent call, not inline tools.

allowed_followup_tools.label: Allowed tools after trigger
allowed_followup_tools.help: Tool names that are always allowed even after a trigger word (e.g. Agent, Task).

ancillary_cmd_prefixes.label: Ancillary command prefixes (always allowed)
ancillary_cmd_prefixes.help: Bash command prefixes that are never blocked regardless of trigger word (e.g. scripts/dev-). Read-only git probes (git status/log/diff/show) and curl with timeout are also always allowed.

_meta.title: Require Monitor paired with every Agent spawn
_meta.description: When ADHD mode is active (~/.myos/.adhd_mode exists), every Agent spawn must be accompanied by a Monitor call in the same turn. Blocks Agent if no Monitor was armed within the sentinel window.

sentinel_ttl_seconds.label: Monitor sentinel lifetime (seconds)
sentinel_ttl_seconds.help: How long after a Monitor call the pairing sentinel stays valid. Agent spawns within this window are allowed.

depth_probe_cadence_seconds.label: Depth-probe check-in interval (seconds)
depth_probe_cadence_seconds.help: How often the Monitor should emit a status update for in-flight agents.

_meta.title: Guard against common Bash foot-guns
_meta.description: Blocks several easy mistakes in Bash calls: curl without a timeout, bare npm run dev, raw vitest, auto-starting servers, assigning to zsh read-only variables, and git stash without a descriptive label.

require_curl_timeout.label: Require --connect-timeout on curl
require_curl_timeout.help: Blocks curl commands that omit --connect-timeout, which can hang indefinitely.

stash_min_label_chars.label: Minimum git stash label length
stash_min_label_chars.help: git stash push -m labels shorter than this are blocked as too vague.

block_npm_dev.label: Block npm/pnpm/yarn run dev
block_npm_dev.help: Redirects to scripts/dev-backend.sh and scripts/dev-frontend.sh, which manage the server lifecycle correctly.

block_bare_vitest.label: Block bare vitest commands
block_bare_vitest.help: Redirects to scripts/run-vitest.sh to avoid orphan worker processes.

block_auto_server_start.label: Block auto-starting dev servers
block_auto_server_start.help: Prevents scripts/dev-backend.sh and scripts/dev-frontend.sh from being called without MYOS_EXPLICIT_START=1.

zsh_reserved_vars.label: Protected zsh variable names
zsh_reserved_vars.help: Assignments to these variable names are blocked because zsh declares them read-only at startup.

_meta.title: Warn when too many uncommitted files pile up
_meta.description: On each new message, checks how many files have uncommitted changes. If the count is at or above the threshold, surfaces a non-blocking reminder to commit before stacking more work.

max_uncommitted_files.label: Uncommitted file threshold
max_uncommitted_files.help: Number of uncommitted files that triggers the reminder. Five is the default from the 2026-04-27 retro.

_meta.title: Auto-close tracked tasks when a commit references them
_meta.description: After each git commit, scans the subject line for →NNN references. If the commit type is in the allowed list (fix, feat, perf, refactor), the matching task is closed automatically.

subject_types_close.label: Commit types that trigger auto-close
subject_types_close.help: Conventional commit prefixes (e.g. fix, feat) that count as resolutions. docs, test, chore do not auto-close.

scan_subject_only.label: Scan subject line only (not body)
scan_subject_only.help: When true, only →NNN references in the first commit line trigger a close. Body references are treated as mentions.

_meta.title: Prefer ostk tools over native Claude tools
_meta.description: When the ostk kernel is running, redirects native Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Grep/Glob calls to their ostk equivalents. In advisory mode it prints a hint; in enforce mode it blocks.

mode.label: Enforcement mode
mode.help: advisory = emit a hint and allow the native call through. enforce = block native calls and require the ostk equivalent.

_meta.title: Route Task spawns through the backend for real isolation
_meta.description: Native Task/Agent calls that look like they will mutate the repo are intercepted and rerouted through /api/agents/spawn, which creates a proper git worktree. Read-only Task calls pass through unchanged.

edit_verbs.label: Verbs that signal a mutation task
edit_verbs.help: If the Task prompt contains any of these words (whole-word, case-insensitive), the call is treated as a mutation and rerouted.

_meta.title: Re-inject HUMANFILE rules on every turn
_meta.description: Reads a HUMANFILE and prepends a curated section of behavioral rules to every user turn, so rules stay active in the model's context throughout a long session.

path.label: HUMANFILE path
path.help: Absolute or ~ path to the HUMANFILE to read. Default is ~/.ostk/HUMANFILE.

_meta.title: Standing rules blocks in every turn header
_meta.description: Injects enforcement blocks into the system prompt on each turn. Each sub-flag controls one block independently: receipts (require evidence before claiming done), stall/death (require 3+ signals before declaring an agent dead), zero-byte transcript (require auth gate before diagnosing silent failures).

receipts_check.label: Receipts check block
receipts_check.help: Requires a commit hash, command output, testid, or file quote for any done/fixed/landed claim.

stall_death_check.label: Stall/death assertion check block
stall_death_check.help: Requires at least 3 of 5 signals (ps, git log, worktree status, transcript tail, /api/agents) before declaring an agent stalled or dead.

zero_byte_transcript_check.label: Zero-byte transcript diagnosis block
zero_byte_transcript_check.help: Requires showing auth status, completed_at/spawned_at, and a verbatim memory quote before citing a root cause for a 0-byte subagent transcript.

_meta.title: Block garbage-titled tasks
_meta.description: Blocks task creation when the title is too short, starts with a placeholder phrase, or is a single throwaway word. Also requires acceptance criteria for P0 and P1 tasks.

ban_words.label: Banned words (anywhere in title)
ban_words.help: Task titles containing these words are blocked as too vague.

single_word_blocklist.label: Blocked single-word titles
single_word_blocklist.help: If the entire title is one of these words, it is blocked as meaningless.

garbage_prefixes.label: Blocked title prefixes
garbage_prefixes.help: Titles starting with any of these strings are blocked as auto-generated or placeholder names.

min_title_length.label: Minimum title length (characters)
min_title_length.help: Titles shorter than this are blocked.

require_ac_for_priorities.label: Priorities that require acceptance criteria
require_ac_for_priorities.help: Task priorities (e.g. P0, P1) that must include an ac field before the task can be created.

_meta.title: Check process is actually dead before reaping it
_meta.description: Prevents the ghost reaper from deleting agents that still have a live process. Uses os.kill(pid, 0) to check whether the process exists before acting on a stale heartbeat.

_meta.title: Block Monitor as a file-read substitute
_meta.description: Monitor is for streaming events (tail -f, polling loops), not one-shot file reads. Blocks Monitor calls that use cat, head, tail without -f, or open/read heredocs.

_meta.title: Surface scaffold-commit warnings from background watchers
_meta.description: Background watchers write warnings to ~/.myos/subagents/scaffold-warnings.jsonl when they detect commits that are structural setup without real functionality. This rule injects those warnings into the next user turn.

max_age_seconds.label: Warning expiry (seconds)
max_age_seconds.help: Warnings older than this are silently dropped. Default is 1800 (30 minutes).

_meta.title: Surface open tasks when asked to keep going
_meta.description: When the user says keep going / continue / next and no agents are running, emits a directive listing open tasks to work on. Never fires on idle turns to avoid autonomous spawning.

trigger_phrases.label: Trigger phrases
trigger_phrases.help: Message prefixes that activate the open-task listing. The check is case-insensitive and matches from the start of the message.

_meta.title: Block cwd-leaks in git-worktree subagents (→1311)
_meta.description: When CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR points to a .claude/worktrees/agent-* path, blocks two leak paths: (1) mcp__ostk__bash git write ops (commit/add/push/stash) without cwd= or with cwd= pointing to the parent repo; (2) mcp__ostk__fs_ops with an absolute path under the parent repo root instead of the worktree. Both patterns cause writes/commits to land on main instead of the agent's isolated branch.

_meta.title: Distinguish hook denies from settings-level denies
_meta.description: Claude Code shows the same message for both hook-based blocks and settings.json permission rules. This rule detects when the canned deny string appears in a recent tool result with no matching hook log entry, indicating a settings-level deny, and surfaces it clearly.

lookback_seconds.label: Tool result lookback window (seconds)
lookback_seconds.help: How far back to scan tool-result files for the canned deny string.
